summary: Neff showcases three Dauntless team setups to beat the S8 endgame boss Mekkatorque, sourced from top-performing Chinese server builds. The classic team with Nathaniel reaches 1.6 billion damage, while the high-end Vortex team featuring Selva reaches over 2 billion damage. A lower-budget option utilizing Tharivol and Torrin delivers around 850 million damage with lower inspiration levels.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Built for pure damage with high attack and crit metrics while maintaining sufficient resistance.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Requires highest attack on the team to receive pet and skill buffs.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: On Chinese servers, Kurvida is often built with skill haste rather than attack speed to maximize Omen debuff uptime.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Equipped with Secrecy set, Angelic Alliance, high accuracy, and resistance.

heroes.name: Nathaniel
heroes.note: Provides team survivability and resistance sharing using Puppeteer set and Golden Antlers.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Enables the 2B+ damage Vortex setup through 15-second rotations with Rift Hourglass and Puppeteer set.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Used in lower-inspiration setups with Vortex Illusion, Puppeteer set, and high resistance.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Built with high skill haste (157+) and Secrecy set to achieve 850M+ damage.

teams.note: Deals 1.6B damage using 17.5s skill rotations and Nathaniel for team protection.
Highest damaging setup reaching 2B+ damage with 15s skill rotations on Kurvida and Selva.
F2P-friendly team achieving ~850M damage with low hero inspiration requirements.

meta_changes: Chinese server meta builds Kurvida with skill haste instead of attack speed to increase Omen debuff application.
tips: Ensure Guinavivre has the highest attack on the team so pet and support buffs target her.
Use Secrecy set and Angelic Alliance artifact on Maashtur for necessary accuracy and resistance stats.
Build Selva with Rift Hourglass and high skill haste to sync her 15-second ultimate rotation.
